newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia starts issue, trading of debt.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia starts issue, trading of debt.

text.p: The Mongolian Stock Exchange on Friday traded discounted government debt worth 70 million tugriks, the exchange said.
"This was the first time Mongolia issued proper debt," an exchange spokesman said. "The trading was a great success."
The 90-day debt was issued at 9,100 tugriks and sold at an average price of 9,118 tugriks, the spokesman said.
The discounted debt will reach 10,000 tugriks on maturity and the profit will be tax-free.
The total value of debt issued on Friday was 300 million tugriks. Tumen Brokerage Company handled 69 percent of the total.
The government has announced it would issue short, medium and long-term debt worth 15 billion tugriks in the 1996/97 fiscal year, with purchase open to foreign investors.
